tldr: Pluto in the 8th house: power becomes personal through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
body:
With Pluto in the 8th house, this part of you intensifies shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to what you share, owe, merge with, grieve, fear, desire, or struggle to control.

When this placement is supported, you can become more honest about trust, attachment, and what is actually shared. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, control, secrecy, or fear can make closeness feel heavier than it needs to be. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
